title: Step 3a - Implementing the Elbow Method for K-Means Clustering in Python

cues.en: Presenter: All right my friends, let's do this.
cues.zh: 講師：好，朋友們，開始吧。

cues.en: Let's use the elbow method to find optimal number of clusters.
cues.zh: 我們用手肘法找出最佳群組數量。

cues.en: So we're gonna use of course, the WCSS, which is the within cluster sum of squares.
cues.zh: 當然會用到 WCSS，也就是群內平方和。

cues.en: I will remind what this is.
cues.zh: 我會再提醒一下它的意思。

cues.en: But first, let's create a new code cell to start this new step of the implementation.
cues.zh: 但先建立新的程式碼儲存格，開始實作這個新步驟。

cues.en: All right, so what are we going to start with here?
cues.zh: 這裡要從什麼開始呢？

cues.en: Well, we're gonna find back our very good friend, PsychLearn because we will actually implement that elbow method with a class of PsychLearn, which, guess what is called?
cues.zh: 我們又要用到好朋友 scikit-learn，因為要用它的一個類別來實作手肘法；猜猜叫什麼？

cues.en: Well, K-Means.
cues.zh: 就是 KMeans。

cues.en: Because indeed, the way we will implement the elbow method, will actually be by running the K-Means algorithm, with several number of clusters.
cues.zh: 因為實作手肘法的方式，其實就是用不同群組數量執行 K-means 演算法。

cues.en: So you see we're gonna run the K-Means algorithm several times, each time with a different number of clusters.
cues.zh: 所以會執行 K-means 很多次，每次使用不同的群組數量。

cues.en: And that's why we have to call that K-Means class that can run this algorithm already.
cues.zh: 因此要呼叫能夠執行這個演算法的 KMeans 類別。

cues.en: And so, well, our first step here will be to start from PsychLearn, from which we're gonna get access to the module that contains that K-Means class,
cues.zh: 第一步先從 sklearn 開始，存取包含 KMeans 類別的模組，

cues.en: and that module is called cluster, just like that.
cues.zh: 這個模組就叫 cluster，像這樣。

cues.en: And then from which we are going to import that K-Means class.
cues.zh: 接著從中匯入 KMeans 類別。

cues.en: Perfect.
cues.zh: 很好。

cues.en: And now, what do you think the next step is going to be?
cues.zh: 你覺得下一步是什麼？

cues.en: Well, exceptionally this time, the next step won't be to create an instance or an object of this K-Means class, because we are about to start a for loop,
cues.zh: 這次是例外，下一步不會先建立 KMeans 類別的實例或物件，因為我們要開始一個 for 迴圈，

cues.en: which will run the K-Means algorithm with 10 different numbers of clusters.
cues.zh: 用 10 種不同的群組數量執行 K-means 演算法。

cues.en: So very simply, we will run the K-Means algorithm with one cluster, then with two clusters, three clusters, et cetera, up to 10 clusters.
cues.zh: 很簡單，就是依序執行一個群組、兩個群組、三個群組，一直到十個群組的 K-means 演算法。

cues.en: And therefore the way to do this is through a loop, and we will do a for loop, because we know exactly, the different numbers of clusters we want to try, which are from one to 10.
cues.zh: 所以要用迴圈，而且用 for 迴圈，因為我們明確知道要嘗試哪些群組數量，就是 1 到 10。

cues.en: And each time we run the K-Means algorithm with these different numbers of clusters, well, we will compute, of course, you know that, famous metric and clustering, which is,
cues.zh: 每次以不同群組數量執行 K-means 演算法時，當然會計算你已經知道的那個著名分群指標，

cues.en: as I told you at the beginning, WCSS, the within cluster sum of squares, which I remind is defined as the sum of the square distances
cues.zh: 也就是開頭提到的 WCSS，群內平方和。提醒一下，它定義為距離平方的總和，

cues.en: between each observation point of the cluster and its central width, the cental width of the cluster.
cues.zh: 距離是指群組中每個觀測點到該群組質心的距離。

cues.en: So we're gonna compute that sum of these square distances, and this is exactly what will be on the Y axis in the graph of the elbow method.
cues.zh: 我們會計算這些距離平方的總和，這正是手肘法圖表 Y 軸上的數值。

cues.en: Remember, the graph in the elbow method contains in the X axis, where the different numbers of clusters we will try, from one to 10,
cues.zh: 記得手肘法圖表的 X 軸，是我們要嘗試的不同群組數量，從 1 到 10，

cues.en: and in the Y axis, it contains the WCSS computed for each of these numbers of clusters.
cues.zh: Y 軸則是每個群組數量所對應的 WCSS。

cues.en: And therefore here, what we have to do right before starting this for loop, is to create a list which will, through the for loop,
cues.zh: 因此，開始 for 迴圈前，要先建立一個串列，在執行 for 迴圈的過程中，

cues.en: be populated with the successive WCSS values for each of the numbers of clusters.
cues.zh: 依序填入每個群組數量對應的 WCSS 值。

cues.en: And therefore we're gonna call that list WCSS, which we will initialize as an empty list.
cues.zh: 我們把這個串列命名為 wcss，初始化為空串列。

cues.en: Remember that lists in Python, are written in a pair of square brackets.
cues.zh: 記得 Python 的串列寫在一對方括號裡。

cues.en: So here in this per square brackets, we're gonna add, one-by-one, the different WCSS values for each of the numbers of clusters.
cues.zh: 所以會在這對方括號中，逐一加入各個群組數量對應的 WCSS 值。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now we can start the for loop.
cues.zh: 現在可以開始 for 迴圈。

cues.en: So the way to write a for loop in Python, is to start with for, then we choose a name of the iterative variable which you know will be incremented by one each time in each iteration of the loop,
cues.zh: 在 Python 中寫 for 迴圈，先寫 for，再為迭代變數取名；這個變數在每次迴圈迭代時都會加一，

cues.en: and the classic name for that variable is I, and then we add in range, and here we specify in parenthesis, well, the values,
cues.zh: 慣用名稱是 i，接著加上 in range，並在括號中指定數值，

cues.en: we want this index of the loop to take over the iterations.
cues.zh: 也就是希望這個迴圈索引在迭代時依序取到的值。

cues.en: And here that's very simple.
cues.zh: 這裡很簡單。

cues.en: I will actually take the different values of the numbers of clusters we want to try, which are from one to 10 included.
cues.zh: i 會依序取到要嘗試的各個群組數量，也就是 1 到 10，包含 10。

cues.en: But remember, ranges in Python include the lower bound, but exclude the upper bound.
cues.zh: 但記得，Python 的範圍包含下限，不包含上限。

cues.en: That's actually what we see here.
cues.zh: 這裡其實就有顯示。

cues.en: Start defaults to zero.
cues.zh: start 預設為 0。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the default lower bound, and stop is emitted, right?
cues.zh: 這是預設下限，而 stop 會省略，對吧？

cues.en: It is excluded.
cues.zh: 也就是不包含在範圍內。

cues.en: So that's why I also really like Google CoLab.
cues.zh: 這也是我很喜歡 Google Colab 的原因。

cues.en: You have all the info in this little help window, but I'm also here for the explanation, so there you go.
cues.zh: 這個小小的說明視窗裡有所有資訊，不過我也會在這裡解釋，就是這樣。

cues.en: The range we have to input here is from one, the first number of cluster we will try, and then up to not 10, but 11,
cues.zh: 所以這裡要輸入的範圍從 1，也就是第一個要嘗試的群組數量，接著不是到 10，而是到 11，

cues.en: because we want to include 10, and therefore we have to go up to 11, which is excluded.
cues.zh: 因為要包含 10，就得寫到不包含在內的 11。

cues.en: All right, and then we add just a little column, just like that, and then we start the for loop.
cues.zh: 接著加上一個冒號，像這樣，就開始 for 迴圈。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now we can come the next natural step, after we import this class, the K-Means class, because indeed, now we can create our first K-Means object.
cues.zh: 現在可以進行匯入 KMeans 類別後的自然下一步，因為現在能建立第一個 KMeans 物件了。

cues.en: Why do I say our first K-Means object?
cues.zh: 為什麼說第一個 KMeans 物件？

cues.en: That's because, once again, we're gonna create 10 different K-Means object for each of these numbers of clusters from one to 10.
cues.zh: 因為再說一次，我們會為 1 到 10 的每種群組數量，建立 10 個不同的 KMeans 物件。

cues.en: So here we're creating the first K-Means algorithm, which will be run with therefore one cluster, because I here starts at one.
cues.zh: 這裡先建立第一個 K-means 演算法，因為 i 從 1 開始，所以它會以一個群組執行。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let's create our first K-Means object, which represents exactly the K-Means algorithm, which will be run to identify, well, actually, some one cluster.
cues.zh: 來建立第一個 KMeans 物件，它代表的正是要執行的 K-means 演算法，用來辨識一個群組。

cues.en: You see what I mean?
cues.zh: 你懂我的意思嗎？

cues.en: And then I will be equal to two, so that new K-Means algorithm will be run to identify two clusters, and then a new K-Means algorithm will be run to identify three clusters, et cetera, up to 10.
cues.zh: 接著 i 等於 2，新的 K-means 演算法會辨識兩個群組；再建立新的演算法辨識三個群組，依此類推到十個。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: That's our first object, which we create by calling, of course, the K-Means class.
cues.zh: 這是第一個物件，當然是透過呼叫 KMeans 類別來建立。

cues.en: Be careful with the capital letters.
cues.zh: 注意大寫字母。

cues.en: K-Means class, we add some parenthesis, and now we import the arguments.
cues.zh: KMeans 類別加上一對括號，現在輸入引數。
